capabilities: Capture a photo from an iPhone via Continuity Camera and embed it at the cursor
Save captures as PNGs in an iPhone Photos subfolder beside the note
Trigger capture with a hotkey, right-click menu, or command palette
Cancel or undo captures while typing continues
Configure the hotkey and the camera helper's .app path in settings
extras: Mac-only and unreviewed by Obsidian staff; the helper must be downloaded and installed manually, and macOS updates may require helper updates because it uses a private camera interface.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to snap a photo with a nearby iPhone and insert it directly into the note being edited.

relations.evidence: Requires Obsidian 1.13.7 or later and Continuity Camera working in Finder.

summary: macOS plugin that captures a photo with your iPhone via Continuity Camera and embeds it as a PNG at the cursor.
